content.positive: My family and I stayed at this Colombo hotel for 4 nights during the holidays. We were warmly greeted by the front office team who helped us with our luggage and check-in process. The staff were friendly and welcoming throughout our stay, always willing to assist with a smile. Our room was clean and spacious, and the bed was very comfortable. The breakfast buffet had a great selection of Sri Lankan and international dishes. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend this hotel to others.

content.headline: Maintenance issues on upper floors
content.negative: During our 3-night stay in Colombo, we were disappointed to find the bathroom drainage system malfunctioning on the upper floor of our hotel. The worn fittings made it difficult to use the facilities without causing a mess. Although the staff tried their best to fix the issue, it persisted throughout our stay. This problem is not new as we observed similar issues in another part of the hotel during our last visit.

content.headline: Slow Breakfast Buffet Service
content.negative: We stayed at this hotel for two nights and had high expectations, but unfortunately, the breakfast buffet service was a letdown. During peak hours, it took a long time to replenish the items on the spread. I witnessed guests waiting patiently, only to find that their favorite dishes were not available. We even informed the staff about the issue, but it didn't get resolved promptly. Considering the hotel's luxury rating, we expected better management of the breakfast service.

content.headline: Late-night Noise Issue at Cinnamon Grand
content.negative: We stayed here for a wedding function and the location was perfect, but unfortunately, the noise from the events continued till past midnight in our room on the third floor (room number: unknown). It was quite disturbing. Despite the luxury hotel's excellent amenities, we were unable to get a good night's sleep. For future guests, it might be worth asking about event schedules or opting for rooms further away.

content.headline: Uncomfortable Night due to Delayed Cooling
content.negative: I'm extremely disappointed with the air conditioning in my room at this hotel. It took over an hour for it to cool down after I complained multiple times. As a frequent business traveler, I expect a comfortable stay. Unfortunately, my meeting was affected because I had to keep adjusting my shirt. The lobby area was cold and refreshing, but not what I experienced in my room. Will consider this before booking again.

content.headline: Excellent hotel team
content.positive: Just returned from a lovely stay at this Colombo luxury hotel! I was immediately impressed by the warm welcome we received from the front-office team - they were so friendly and helpful throughout our entire arrival process. We even got upgraded to a beautiful room with a stunning view of the city. The staff were attentive, courteous, and always available when needed. Smooth check-in, hassle-free amenities, and excellent housekeeping. Highly recommend this hotel for its exceptional service and wonderful experience.

content.headline: Mixed stay
content.negative: We stayed at this hotel on a Friday evening and were greeted by a long queue at the check-in counter. Despite having a reservation, we waited for over 30 minutes to get our room key. The staff seemed overwhelmed and unfriendly. The hotel's luxury reputation was tarnished in that moment.

content.headline: Disappointing Drainage Issues
content.negative: We stayed on the upper floor of this supposedly luxurious hotel in Colombo for three nights. Unfortunately, our experience was marred by recurring problems with the bathroom drainage system. Water would accumulate outside the shower and toilet areas, creating a mess that wasn't just unpleasant but also hazardous. The worn-out fixtures didn't help, making it seem like no one had bothered to maintain these areas in a while. For a hotel of this caliber, such issues are unacceptable.
